title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. translated_title: CLEAT：为交互式智能体学习价值导向的澄清机制
translated_abstract: LLM智能体能够执行日益复杂的任务，但有效的辅助还要求其行动与用户可能未明确说明的目标和约束保持一致。我们将该问题作为通过澄清实现的交互式意图对齐进行研究。然而，只有当智能体能够将答案转化为更好的决策时，澄清才是有用的。由于训练会改变智能体处理不完整信息以及利用额外答案的方式，同一个澄清可能变得更有用或更无用。我们提出了CLEAT（通过价值导向的智能体协同训练实现澄清），这是一个基于共享交互结果，协同训练澄清价值控制器与任务策略的框架。我们形式化了残差查询价值，用以衡量在当前策略下通过提问而非直接行动所获得的任务效用，并通过来自同一交互历史的成对rollout来估计该价值。这些成对回报用于训练控制器预测澄清的价值。
tldr: 提出CLEAT框架，通过残差查询价值的估计，从共享交互结果中协同训练澄清价值控制器与任务策略，使LLM智能体学会判断何时提出澄清问题才能真正提升任务效用。
en_tdlr: CLEAT co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy by estimating residual query value from paired rollouts, enabling LLM agents to learn when asking clarifying questions genuinely improves task utility.
